nodes.Name: maxFileBytes
nodes.DocComment: maxFileBytes caps a single file read served to the reviewer pane.

nodes.Name: outDirInfo
nodes.DocComment: outDirInfo describes one candidate output folder for the picker.

nodes.Name: baseAndRoot
nodes.DocComment:
baseAndRoot returns the absolute projects base and root, or an error string
when the base is not configured.

nodes.Name: withinBase
nodes.DocComment: withinBase reports whether abs is the base or a descendant (no ".." escape).

nodes.Name: GenerateBase
nodes.DocComment:
GenerateBase handles GET /api/generate/base — the base + root for the UI so it
can explain the boundary and disable the picker when no base is set.

nodes.Name: GenerateOutdirs
nodes.DocComment:
GenerateOutdirs handles GET /api/generate/outdirs — immediate subdirectories of
the base, each flagged so the UI can show which are empty / already generated /
the current root (which is not selectable).

nodes.Name: GenerateMkdir
nodes.DocComment:
GenerateMkdir handles POST /api/generate/mkdir {name} — create a new folder
directly under the base (single path segment, no separators). Returns the
created absolute path.

nodes.Name: treeNode
nodes.DocComment: treeNode is one node in the generated-file tree.

nodes.Name: GenerateTree
nodes.DocComment:
GenerateTree handles GET /api/generate/tree?dir= — the file tree of a generated
output folder, bounded to the base. Skips heavy/noise dirs.

nodes.Name: skipDir
nodes.DocComment: skipDir is the set of directory names not worth showing in the reviewer.
nodes.ValueLiteral: map[string]bool{"node_modules": true, ".git": true, ".gen": true, "vendor": true, "dist": true, "build": true, ".next": true}

nodes.Name: buildTree
nodes.DocComment: buildTree walks abs to a bounded depth, returning a sorted tree (dirs first).

nodes.Name: GenerateFile
nodes.DocComment:
GenerateFile handles GET /api/generate/file?path= — read one text file, bounded
to the base and capped in size. Returns {path, content, truncated}.
